title: MC ULTRA
description: Vanilla+ modpack with lots of new animations, 3d models and vibrant graphics
body:
![MC ULTRA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0de86bf9ca5698b641956883ea912dea60236a6.png)
## MC ULTRA
Vanilla+ modpack aimed to enhance Minecraft’s visuals, animations, and overall atmosphere without changing the core gameplay.
## Modpack changes
- music
- sounds
- particles
- first-person animations
- player animations
- 3D models
- textures
- increased render distance
- inventory improvements
- UI improvements
- optimization
- new structures and massive world generation
## Graphics 
### You can choose between two options:
- Play with shaderpacks (only supported by the voxy mod → [supported shader list](https://samalando.com/voxy/shaders))
- play with [vfx+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/visual-effects-plus) (VFX+ MUST BE ABOVE OTHERS TO PREVENT CONFLICTS)
![VFX+ MUST BE ABOVE ALL OTHER RESOURCE PACKS TO PREVENT CONFLICTS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78bfb3cc28a5c09b053aa485a7da491f710c4a6a.png)

## Performance note
- Recommended RAM: 6–8 GB
- It is not recommended to use VFX+ and shaderpacks at the same time — choose only one option to avoid visual conflicts and performance issues.
## Version
Modpack is available for 1.21.11 fabric
